the_day: OpenAI is reported to be close to a $30 billion funding round at a lower valuation and launched a Decisions API. Anthropic published research on a UK cyber-testing incident and on formal verification. Google brought Gemini to cars and Chrome, Meta changed its terms for AI-edited ads, and xAI's SpaceXSI signed a partnership with Tech Mahindra.
